notes: Account: mid-tier trading desk within global bank. Evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency during market open windows.
Primary contact: CTO (Ravi Patel) + Head of ML Infra (Anya Volkov). Procurement lead: Caroline Muir.
They run a high-frequency reranking pipe: peak concurrency ~1800 qps, typical burst to 3k during open/close. Need throughput guarantees for bursts.
Key ask in negotiations: 99.99% uptime for dedicated pool during contracted business hours (6:00-20:00 ET).
They requested an explicit credit schedule: sliding scale - 5% ARR credit if <99.99, 10% for <99.9, pro-rated for longer outages. Procurement pushed for 15% cap; legal pushing back.

Maintenance windows: prefer scheduled maintenance during 02:00-04:00 ET; will accept 1 quarterly maintenance event of up to 4 hours with advance notice. NO maintenance allowed during market open/close windows.
Support: P1 (production outage) 30 min response, 2 hour mitigation SLA; P2 2 hour response; 24/7 phone escalation for P1. Redwood proposed 1 hour for P1 — customer pushing 30m.
Latency SLOs discussed: p95 end-to-end generation latency <200ms for 128-token prompts on dedicated A100-equivalent pool; p99 <350ms. They asked for measured baselines on their sample prompt set.
Throughput guarantees: committed 30K tokens/sec sustained with autoscaling headroom for bursts up to 60K tokens/sec for 10 minutes. They want explicit billing treatment for burst capacity.

Reserved GPU planning: initial reservation 12 x H100-equivalent GPUs for dedicated pool (estimated), with ability to expand +4 GPUs monthly. Want guaranteed replacement time SLA for failed GPU nodes (<4 hours to replace) or fallback model variant routing.
Data controls: all inference logs must be retained for 90 days and accessible via S3-compatible export; KMS integration mandatory for key wrapping of customer data at rest.
Routing/fallback: must support automatic fallback to quantized LLM variant if primary model capacity saturated with no impact to SLA (explicit acceptance criteria needed).
Quote from CTO: "We need warranty that market hours stay online — a single 15-min outage at open is business critical."
Legal wants explicit definitions: downtime vs degradation (latency spikes). Need a clear incident classification table in contract.
Action items: SE to run 48-hour stress test with customer's prompt corpus (Jira: INF-7842). Procurement asked for updated SOW with credit table in call on 2026-03-09.
Risk: SOC2 gap from vendor-side pen test; security team requested Redwood's pen test report and any outstanding findings.
Customer is cost-sensitive but values deterministic performance; willing to sign 12-month committed reserved capacity if SLAs acceptable.
Meeting refs: drive pricing deck reviewed 2026-02-18 (link above); Fireflies 2026-02-18 ff_20260218_gh3k2 transcript summary attached.
